extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors and readers, especially editors of biographies of living persons (English Wikipedia)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and maintaining an English Wikipedia biography of a living person, emphasizing neutrality, reliable sourcing, and site style conventions. Applies to content and section-level maintenance notes visible on the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neutrality warning for controversy section
rubrics_metrics.description: This "criticism" or "controversy" section may compromise the article's neutrality. Please help integrate negative information into other sections or remove undue focus on minor aspects through discussion on the talk page. (May 2025)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid stand-alone 'controversy' sections that create undue weight. Integrate criticism into appropriate topical sections, ensure balance and proportionality, and use the article's talk page for discussion about restructuring or removing undue focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: BLP sourcing requirement / removal of unsourced contentious material
rubrics_metrics.description: This section of a biography of a living person does not include any references or sources. Please help by adding reliable sources. Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately, especially if potentially libelous or harmful. (August 2016)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any material about living persons that is contentious or potentially libelous requires immediate sourcing from reliable sources; otherwise it should be removed. Editors should add citations to reputable sources or delete/modify unsourced claims without delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section-level sourcing (filmography / selected filmography)
rubrics_metrics.description: This section of a biography of a living person does not include any references or sources. Please help by adding reliable sources. Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately, especially if potentially libelous or harmful. (August 2016)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists such as filmography still require verifiability. Add citations for entries (e.g., to credits, databases, or published sources) and avoid unsourced or speculative credits in sections about living people.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use American English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article language and spelling should follow American English conventions for this article per the project/language variant tag; apply consistent spelling and usage throughout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mdy dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates in the article should follow the month-day-year (MDY) format consistently in prose and templates, per the article's date-format setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation template / archival maintenance (CS1 / webarchive notices)
rubrics_metrics.description: CS1 maint: deprecated archival service; Webarchive template wayback links (hidden maintenance categories shown on the article).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix deprecated or maintenance-flagged citation templates: replace deprecated archival-service parameters, ensure webarchive/Wayback links are correctly formatted and functional, and update citations to current, supported templates to remove maintenance tags.
